input.value: grease fire from stovetop while sauteing onions; contained with fire extinguisher
charred kitchen cabinets above stove, smoke damage to ceiling and walls

input.rationale: Damage to the policyholder's own kitchen cabinets and interior surfaces from an accidental grease fire is clearly property damage to the home's contents and structure.

Charred cabinetry and smoke damage to multiple surfaces (ceiling and walls) across the kitchen suggests damage in the $2,000–$25,000 range, requiring professional restoration and possibly cabinet replacement.

input.claim_summary: Kitchen fire caused by grease flare-up on stovetop; policyholder extinguished it with a fire extinguisher. Charred kitchen cabinets above the stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls. No injuries. Damage estimated in the medium range ($2k–$25k), requiring professional cleanup and cabinet restoration.
